C1.axis_reason: calibration is tied lowest (7, with depth and adjacency; SCORECARD round-28 section) and is an assigned axis (../shokunin.conf:52 operability + calibration). AXES.md signal: SHONEN.md/SCORECARD entries match observed repo state. The counter checks each statement at the revision that WROTE it, so a mismatch is an error at writing (overreach or a wrong pointer), not later drift (the round-25 axis-fit ruling filed drift under freshness).
C1.surface: SCORECARD.md and SHONEN.md self-assessment statements: the lane gains a check of six statement classes against the repo at each statement's writing revision, and an appended SCORECARD.md section that records the observed value of every base statement found false. Before this round no lane instrument checked SCORECARD/SHONEN statements at their writing revision (tools/citation-provenance.py checks registered cite() tokens; tools/prereg-time-check.py checks ISO times of one file against its own commit). The command that shows it unmoved is the same counter at base: unresolved 11.
C1.claimed_work: For each base statement the frozen check finds false at its writing revision, append one row to SCORECARD.md under the heading '## Round 29 — self-assessment corrections' that names the statement id and states the check's observed value. The improvement is the corrected self-assessment; the instrument that finds the statements is part of the move. A policy that runs the frozen check and records its observed values performs this work; it is the reference policy, not a control.
C1.predicate: A base statement is one checkable assertion that the frozen extractor finds on a line of SCORECARD.md or SHONEN.md at base 2aa46e2481d2ec41a7ee5ed793fc50ae967a6e5d; its writing revision W is the commit git blame --line-porcelain names for that line; it HOLDS iff its class check (P pointer, H digest, N line count, C commit, T time, Q quoted output; count-c1.py docstring) passes against the lane tree and history at W. A base statement is UNRESOLVED iff it does not hold and the tip SCORECARD.md does not carry exactly one valid correction row for it (first cell SA29:<sid>, last cell the observed value the counter prints, under the frozen heading); every false correction row (names a holding statement or no base statement, wrong observed value, duplicate sid) counts as one more unresolved; a tip SCORECARD.md that does not begin with the base bytes makes every base statement unresolved.
C1.command: /usr/bin/python3 .ufo/waves/round-29/count-c1.py --tip refs/heads/master --out <fresh receipt.json> (run from a fresh clone of the lane remote; --repo <clone>)
C1.target: mismatched_at_base >= 1 and unresolved == 0 at the measured lane tip (receipt field met)
C1.kill_rule: A miss under this predicate is reported as a miss. The predicate, counter, extractor and target are never amended, re-scaled or narrowed after this freeze; a counter defect found later is disclosed as a limit, never repaired for this claim.

controls_planned_before_data: CtlDeletion: delete the false lines from SCORECARD.md/SHONEN.md in place
CtlEditInPlace: rewrite the false statements in place to true text, no correction rows
CtlJunk: frozen heading plus 11 rows with random sids and values
CtlAllFalse: one row per extracted statement with its class's failure string
CtlLabelKeyed: rows keyed on sids computed from the base SCORECARD/SHONEN text alone, observed = the statement token (echo)
CtlNoReader: rows written without opening the lane repo (from this preregistration and the class names only)
CtlTypeGuess: rows for every P and Q statement with the class failure string (type rule, no check)
CtlSourceBounds: rows for statements predicted false from the statement text alone (no blob at any revision opened)
CtlBaseTree: each statement checked against the base tree instead of W (skips the history), rows for those found false
CtlWorkingTree: correct rows written to the working tree and never committed
CtlObjectStore: correct rows reachable only through a git replace ref / alternate object store
CtlDuplicate: every correct row written twice
RefPaste (reference policy, not a control): run the frozen counter and record its observed values; expected to meet
C1.sources: C1 rests on git's documented semantics for blame (writing revision of a line), merge-base --is-ancestor, committer time and grep pathspec exclusion; SOURCES rows for those manual pages are opened this round by wave-1 scribes and cited by the round's knowledge entry and SCORECARD section.
